{{Quote|Woah! Hey! Woolies, make some room! I wanna look, see? ...Black Shores member, Encore, reporting in!|Encore}}

{{Intro/Resonator}} She is from the [[New Federation]] and a Consultant of the [[Black Shores]]. With her vivid imagination, her Wooly companions, Cosmos and Cloudy, and a penchant for crafting fairy tales, she is responsible for finding new clients for the Black Shores alongside her fellow Consultant and brother figure [[Aalto]].

==Official Introduction==
{{Quote|Encore, a consultant from the Black Shores, is a quirky, lively, and spunky girl who loves to recount her friendships and adventures through fantasy and fairy tales.

She always has two Woolies with her, who are Encore's best friends and protectors.

With Cosmos and Cloudy, Encore travels all over the world!|[https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/en/main#resonators Her introduction on the Official Website.]
}}
